status: experimental coordination architecture; no legal-enforceability or autonomous-settlement claim
purpose: Represent negotiation, counteroffers, partial acceptance, amendment, withdrawal, mediation, and settlement proposals between humans, institutions, and agents without allowing negotiation state to mint authority or coerce execution.
principles: silence is not acceptance unless a separately valid local rule explicitly says otherwise
partial acceptance binds only the explicitly accepted terms
withdrawal ends the offer state prospectively but does not erase prior evidence
amendments are versioned deltas over exact prior agreement digests
material amendments require renewed acceptance by every party whose obligations, rights, risk, data exposure, or authority-relevant context changes
agent proposals cannot bind sponsors, organizations, or humans beyond delegated authority
mediators may facilitate or propose but do not become adjudicators or authority roots merely by being selected
settlement acceptance does not itself authorize payments, transfers, releases, suspensions, or other consequential effects
anti_coercion: no hidden penalty for requesting clarification
no automatic escalation from rejection to punishment
materially changed terms must be surfaced
high-consequence acceptance may require human-readable summary and independent review
pressure, urgency, or reputation signals cannot substitute for consent or authority
compatibility_rules: existing intent-contract remediation proposals remain separate from bilateral/multilateral negotiation
existing governance amendment flows may consume negotiation evidence but remain authoritative only through their own charter/policy process
version negotiation for protocols remains a technical compatibility function, not contractual assent
nonclaims: This profile does not determine whether an offer or amendment is legally binding.
This profile does not implement arbitration, courts, or enforcement.
This profile does not create a universal bargaining strategy.
This profile does not authorize financial settlement or external asset transfer.
